description: The pnpm-lockfile workspace on npm workspaces, with real npm-generated lockfiles. npm hoists every dependency, so docs-site can (and does) import clsx without declaring it.

scenarios.name: direct-dependency-bump
scenarios.description: clsx 2.1.0 → 2.1.1 (lockfile only). ui declares it; docs-site imports it WITHOUT declaring it, which works because npm hoists: both run, plus ui's dependent app.

scenarios.name: lock-maintenance
scenarios.description: debug 4.3.4 → 4.3.7 and ms 2.1.2 → 2.1.3 (lockfile only): utils (ms), logger (debug → ms) and utils' dependents run; docs-site does not.

scenarios.name: root-dependency-bump
scenarios.description: typescript is a root devDependency, visible to every package: everything runs.

scenarios.name: integrity-only-change
scenarios.description: Same version, different tarball: only the package that uses it runs.
